title: 'It's a crime': UP CEO on alteration of 10,470 Pilbhit voters after SIR final roll
content: Uttar Pradesh's chief electoral officer revealed that two electoral officials and a computer operator have been implicated in voter record manipulation. A total of 10,470 voter records were altered without any supporting applications found in the offices. The manipulation was discovered after a voter noticed discrepancies in his registration details and reported them. Legal actions include criminal charges and potential disciplinary measures against the officials involved in the case.

title: Ontario farmer turned down C$16m for 164 acres; 29 acres protected for 999 years

This easement effectively restricts future development for nearly 1,000 years, ensuring continued agricultural use. Their decision counters pressures from developers seeking to convert farmland into housing. The Stevens family aims to preserve the land for future generations of farmers.

title: 5 dead as blast rips through house storing firecrackers in Bihar village

Authorities are looking into the licensing and safety practices related to firecracker storage in the area.

title: Netanyahu orders sweeping West Bank offensive after deadly Hebron attack

This strategy includes imposing movement restrictions on Palestinians and conducting extensive weapon searches. With national elections looming on October 27, Netanyahu's government feels compelled to respond decisively amidst escalating violence and coalition partner pressures.

title: JJ Watt's $100,000 Harvey gift grew into $41.6m fund, helped rebuild 600+ homes
content: In 2017, former NFL star J.J. Watt donated $100,000 to launch a fundraiser for Hurricane Harvey victims in Texas. Initially targeting $200,000, the campaign eventually raised $41.6 million by August 2018. The money helped rebuild more than 600 homes, restore over 420 childcare centres, distribute 26 million meals and provide healthcare to thousands.

title: Ryan Gosling and Eva Mendes bought retreat made from 200-year-old barns in 2014
content: In 2014, Ryan Gosling and Eva Mendes purchased a distinctive rustic estate in Carpinteria, California. This property, crafted by Joel Schumacher, is constructed from reclaimed wood of three 200-year-old barns. Designed for privacy and a serene connection to nature, it embodies American history, offering a tranquil retreat from Los Angeles. The couple cherishes their family life away from the spotlight, valuing their children and preserving the estate's unique features.

title: After renaming Lake Ontario, Google CEO rejects US request to rename Atlantic Ocean

During a recent event, he mentioned contacting Google Maps regarding these renaming efforts. Google CEO Sundar Pichai reportedly declined his proposal on the grounds that oceans encompass multiple countries. This follows the US administration's earlier renaming of Lake Ontario to Lake America for US users.

title: Josh Allen and Hailee Steinfeld’s $15M homes: Inside their luxury estates

title: After historic best-ever haul, where will India finish in Asian Para Games standings?

This achievement not only broke their last record of 108 medals but also marked a significant shift in India's sporting landscape. Athletics emerged as the strongest discipline, asserting India's dominance despite South Korea's attempts to compete.

title: Travis Kelce’s alleged $12.5M Pennsylvania mansion purchase sparks questions

The luxurious estate has fuelled questions about the couple’s future living arrangements and privacy. However, the reported transaction is fictional, with no verified evidence confirming the purchase. Until reliable sources or official statements emerge, claims about the couple’s potential property move should be treated cautiously.

title: Dylan Larkin trade: Why are the Red Wings demanding a premium despite fair NHL offers?
content: The Detroit Red Wings are reportedly weighing multiple trade offers for captain Dylan Larkin but have yet to accept a deal. According to NHL insider Nick Kypreos, Detroit wants a substantially stronger return than the proposals currently available. With Larkin’s trade preferences and contractual protections shaping negotiations, the Red Wings face a key decision over whether to wait or reconsider their demands.

title: India’s Scotch whisky row as firms seek 75% duty instead of 150%
content: India's inquiry into Scotch whisky imports has raised concerns regarding the India–UK trade deal and its benefits. The International Spirits and Wines Association of India has urged government intervention to clarify tariff classifications. Revenue investigators argue that Scotch concentrates should incur a higher import duty despite tariff reductions. The ongoing investigation could significantly impact import costs for Diageo and Pernod Ricard.

title: Why the US midterms matter for Trump & the Democrats - explained in 10 charts
content: Scheduled for November 3, the US midterm elections are poised to significantly influence the current Trump administration. All 435 House seats and 35 Senate positions are up for grabs, making Congressional control pivotal for advancing Trump's policy goals. Voter priorities like the economy, immigration, healthcare, and democracy are expected to heavily sway electoral outcomes, shaping both immediate governance and the political landscape ahead of the 2028 presidential election.

title: Maine landlord agrees $3.6m settlement to repay over 1,000 renters
content: The Trelawny Tenants Union has achieved a significant milestone, settling for $3.6 million with landlord Geoffrey Rice over improper rent hikes. This reimbursement, affecting more than 1,000 residents for overpayments since 2020, stems from ongoing mediation and legal challenges against violations of rent control laws. Moving forward, the union plans to enforce compliance among landlords in Portland and is exploring a digitized rental registration system for better governance.

title: India script history! Best-ever haul as nine golds cap golden day at Asian Para Games
content: India finished its campaign at the Asian Para Games with a record total of 114 medals. This achievement included 30 gold medals, surpassing their previous best in Hangzhou. A significant contribution came from athletics, as athletes excelled in various events, including javelin and club throw. Additionally, badminton players delivered impressive performances, securing multiple gold medals. Shooter Mona Agarwal also achieved world record status in her event.

title: Einstein's 1929 handwritten letter filled with equations sold for $71,811
content: A handwritten letter by Albert Einstein, believed to date back to around 1929, has sold for $71,811 at RR Auction. Addressed to mathematician Chaim Herman Muntz, the one-page document contains detailed equations exploring Hamiltonian mechanics, covariance and invariance. Written in German, the letter was sold with its original envelope, postmarked in Potsdam, offering a glimpse into Einstein's mathematical discussions nearly a century ago.

title: Why people struggle to part with grandparents' belongings, says psychology
content: Objects passed down through generations often evoke strong feelings, leading to uncertainty about their future. Donating pieces linked to family memories can seem like losing a part of oneself. Research shows that maintaining intact collections strengthens familial ties. Heirs tend to part with belongings if they trust their histories will be acknowledged. Identifying appropriate recipients can help assure these cherished items are used with respect rather than thrown away.

title: Amex to cut 3,500 jobs globally despite raising 2026 profit forecast
content: In a bid to boost operational efficiency, American Express announced it will be laying off around 3,500 employees worldwide. Despite reporting better-than-expected third-quarter earnings and upgrading its full-year forecast for 2026, the company is dealing with a decline in billed business and a looming regulatory fine for compliance issues. This restructuring is aimed at enhancing workflow while ensuring continued growth and customer loyalty.

title: Asian Para Games: Sumit Antil leads India's javelin 1-2-3; Pranav strikes gold again
content: India's para-athletes had a remarkable performance at the Asian Para Games, securing two gold medals. Sumit Antil maintained his dominance in the men's javelin throw with a top distance of 72.46m, while Pranav Soorma broke records to defend his men's club throw F51 title. Complementing their achievements, Mahendra Gurjar earned silver, and Sandip Sanjay Sargar claimed bronze in javelin, boosting India's standing in the competition.

title: George Washington artwork hidden in folder for 60 years sold for $226,600
content: A remarkable early 19th-century folk art piece, showcasing George Washington, has achieved a staggering auction price of $226,600 after lying dormant for 60 years. This striking artwork embodies the fraktur tradition of Pennsylvania German heritage, adorned with patriotic imagery. The strong interest stemmed from its superb condition and rich historical context, illustrating the enduring passion for distinguished American folk art among collectors and institutions alike.

title: Lauren Conrad bought Beverly Hills penthouse for $1.35m, sold for $2.8m

After extensive renovations, she transformed the space into a modern home with high-end finishes. The penthouse includes a large open-plan living area, multiple bedrooms, and outdoor terraces. Conrad's real estate ventures in Southern California continue to show significant financial returns.

title: UK man's 20-year Spitfire garage project sold for £18,000 after his death
content: Peter Arnold, affectionately dubbed 'Mr Spitfire', dedicated over half a century to amassing historic aircraft relics. After his passing in 2025, a remarkable unfinished Spitfire fuselage went under the hammer for £18,000. This Spitfire F Mk 22 PK519 fuselage featured original components, resting in Arnold's garage for 20 years. Besides the fuselage, auctioned treasures included vintage aircraft instruments and a mesmerizing clock.

title: Meet India's flag-bearers at Asiad closing ceremony: Mona Agarwal and Nishad Kumar

title: German detectorist finds 15 coins; archaeologists unearth 934 Roman denarii
content: amateur metal detectorist Oliver Riedl found 15 silver coins buried under a field in western Germany . when his detector kept beeping he suspected there was more under the soil . he alerted archaeologists who recovered 934 roman silver coins that had been buried for nearly 2,000 years .

title: Gunmen open fire inside church in Jordan, 6 killed
content:
Six people were killed and 28 others injured after two unidentified gunmen opened fire at a church in Jordan’s Karak region during a funeral procession, Reuters reported, citing Al-Mamlaka TV. According to a source cited by the broadcaster, the attackers got out of a vehicle and began shooting. A witness told Al-Mamlaka TV that the gunmen fired continuously for about five minutes before fleeing the scene. A witness told state-run Al-Mamlaka television that one of the attackers was armed with an AK-47 Kalashnikov rifle. The attack took place at a Greek Orthodox church in Karak, located about 180 kilometres (110 miles) south of the Jordanian capital, Amman. Karak is home to a minority Christian community.This is a developing story. Details to follow

End of Article

title: UP polls: Congress shares initial list with SP, seeks 175-200 seats
content: the Congress has formally begun seat-sharing negotiations with the Samajwadi Party (SP) in poll-bound Uttar Pradesh . the list was shared with SP leaders around two days ago . leaders from both parties will soon hold detailed discussions on the nature of a seat-share arrangement .

title: Russia-Ukraine war: Melania's 'intervention' secures one-city ceasefire
content: the temporary halt in military action is intended to allow humanitarian aid to enter the city and facilitate the evacuation of civilians through a designated safe passageway . the situation in Oleshky is dire. the remaining population is comprised of elderly residents who urgently need medical attention, medicine, food, and clean water .

title: US midterms: Democrats sniff opportunity, Trump fights lame-duck presidency

title: Illinois couple replaced lawn; 5 years later, 130+ native plant species grow
content: crystal Fritz and James Reed McGuire moved from a Chicago condominium to Highland Park, Illinois, in late 2020 . they decided to create a native garden that could provide food and shelter for birds, bees and other wildlife . over the next five years, they gradually replaced most of the grass across their quarter-acre property, learning through trial and error .

title: ‘Like being raped all over again’: UK detective assaulted by coworker questions probe
content: a detective who was raped by a former Scottish Yard officer has called for the force to resign . detective Constable Linda Williams, 60, was attacked by carrick in 2004 . she brought a civil claim against the metropolitan police for failing to protect her . the case has now been settled for an undisclosed sum .

title: Magnitude 5.2 earthquake strikes Myanmar, no injuries reported
content: 5.2 magnitude earthquake strikes Myanmar at 10.36 pm (local time) no injuries have been reported so far . Myanmar is highly vulnerable to earthquakes and tsunamis due to its location at the convergence of four major tectonic plates: the Indian, Eurasian, Sunda and Burma plates .
